description: This file defines types, functions, and utilities for parsing and converting markdown-like text into a custom Tlon story format, including handling inline elements, block elements, images, and markdown syntax parsing.

methods.name: parseInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Parses markdown-like inline syntax into structured story inline elements.

methods.name: mergeAdjacentStrings
methods.description: Merges consecutive string elements in an inline array for optimization.

methods.name: createImageBlock
methods.description: Creates a story verse containing an image block with specified source, alt text, height, and width.

methods.name: isImageUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL string appears to be an image based on its extension.

methods.name: processInlinesForImages
methods.description: Extracts image markers from inline elements and converts them into separate image blocks.

methods.name: markdownToStory
methods.description: Converts markdown text into a structured story format, handling headers, code blocks, blockquotes, and images.

methods.name: textToStory
methods.description: Converts plain text into a simple story with no markdown parsing.

methods.name: hasMarkdown
methods.description: Detects if a text contains markdown formatting patterns.
